arguments.body:
# CCC Fall 2014 - Module Tracker

Tracking status of course modules for **Creative Computing and Culture (Fall 2014, Canvas course ID 7)**.

Column values for **Status**: `Not Started`, `In Progress`, `Completed`.

| Module_Name | Item_Count | Type_Summary | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Introduction | 15 | 1 Discussion, 9 Files, 3 Pages, 2 Quizzes | Not Started |
| Week 1 | 2 | 2 Files | Not Started |
| Week 3 | 1 | 1 File | Not Started |
| Week 5 | 1 | 1 File | Not Started |
| Week 8 | 1 | 1 File | Not Started |

_Item_Count values reflect the actual number of items retrieved from Canvas. Statuses are initialized to "Not Started" and updated after each weekly module review meeting._
